name: Task Summary
author: TaskBot Labs
description: Summarises your task list - how many items you have, how many are done, and what has been sitting there longest.

invocation.when_to_use: When the user asks for an overview, summary, count or status of their tasks, or wants to know what they have been putting off.

scope.description: Which tasks to include in the summary.

capabilities.reason: Reads your tasks so it can count them and describe them.
